idea-plugin.name: Tokyo Night Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A clean, dark and light Tokyo Night theme for JetBrains IDEs. Ported from the popular Tokyo Night VS Code theme by enkia.

Includes three variants:
  • Tokyo Night — the original dark theme
  • Tokyo Night Storm — a moody, blue-toned dark variant
  • Tokyo Night Light — a warm, low-contrast light variant
